addresses.note: one RDF/XML file per issue, 9200396/BibliographicResource_<n>.xml, its text in rdf:value
one EDM file per issue, http%3A%2F%2Fdata.theeuropeanlibrary.org%2FBibliographicResource%2F<n>.edm.xml, with its rights, date, title and library

licenses.attribution: Europeana Newspapers, National Library of Luxembourg (data provider), The European Library (provider), https://www.europeana.eu/; each issue's title, date and address are in the credit of each document
licenses.text: Public domain. Each issue's own metadata (edm:rights) labels it with the Public Domain Mark 1.0, http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/; the publication's own label is the proof (docs/licenses.md, maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23). An issue enters only with that label and a date of publication (dcterms:issued) in 1955 or earlier, the European Union's term for a newspaper issue (docs/licenses.md, newspaper rule, maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23).
licenses.note: the metadata files are read only for each issue's license value and credit, and give no document

join.name: metadata
join.note: an issue's metadata file has the issue's number, as the full-text file has it

formats.note: one issue per full-text file; its license value and credit come from the metadata file of the same issue

tags.note: fr: the dc:language of every one of the 1,319 metadata files of this library (2026-10-23)
